reference.title: Barbell Seated Good morning
reference.listing: Video (title from the listing URL; the page could not be read from this environment, gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy, so the movement is taken from the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace sitting tall, hold it as you lean forward and come back up, breathe out at the top.
breathing.cadence: About 2 s down, a short pause, about 1.4 s up

prescription.tempo: 2 s down, short pause, 1-1.5 s up
prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen and light: start with an empty bar; the back stays flat at every depth.
prescription.progression: Add 2.5 kg once every rep reaches the same lean with a flat back.

cues.text: Sit tall on the end of a flat bench, feet wide and flat, toes a little out. Bar across the upper traps (as in a back squat), hands just outside the shoulders, elbows down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back, chest leading, the trunk lowering between the thighs.
Stop when the back would have to round to go further; hips stay on the bench.
Squeeze the glutes and lift the chest to sit tall again.
Sit tall, re-brace, then go again.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to go deeper
mistakes.fix: Stop at the depth where the back stays flat.
Squeeze the shoulder blades to make a shelf on the upper traps and hold the bar down into it.
Keep the glutes pressed into the seat; the trunk moves, the hips stay.
Keep the neck in line with the back, eyes on the floor ahead.

kinematics.norm: Seated hinge from about 90 degrees at the hip to a deep forward lean (clinical opinion); good mornings load the hip and back extensors (Vigotsky 2015)
Lean forward about 45-60 degrees from upright with a flat back (clinical opinion)
Neutral spine; avoid loaded spine flexion (McGill 1998)

cautions: Use a light bar; the long lever arm loads the low back a lot.
Take the bar from a rack set at shoulder height when seated, or have it handed to you.
Low-back pain: shorten the range or skip it.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Bar on the neck: use a pad or the safety-squat bar.
regressions: Standing good morning with a dowel.

muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold the spine neutral and lift the trunk back up; the seated version shortens the hamstrings so the back and hips do more (Vigotsky 2015).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold the spine neutral and lift the trunk back up; the seated version shortens the hamstrings so the back and hips do more (Vigotsky 2015).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Extends the hip to sit back up.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Extends the hip to sit back up.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Assist hip extension with the knees bent.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Assist hip extension with the knees bent.
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Adductor magnus assists hip extension in the wide seat.
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Adductor magnus assists hip extension in the wide seat.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Squeeze the shoulder blades to hold the bar.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Squeeze the shoulder blades to hold the bar.
muscleNotes.lats_r: Pull the bar down into the back.
muscleNotes.lats_l: Pull the bar down into the back.
